jobs.title: Associate Consultant | Full Stack Developer - AI
jobs.description: About Us About the Company Viscadia is a leading consulting firm focused on forecasting for life sciences. We help pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies make high-stakes decisions with greater clarity and confidence, with teams across the United States, Europe, and India. We are deeply committed to a vision of shared growth and success for our clients, colleagues, and communities. About the Role We are seeking an Associate Consultant to join our India team based in Gurgaon. This role at Viscadia offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of full-stack and cloud software development, system design, artificial intelligence, healthcare analytics, and consulting. You will contribute to the design, development, and enhancement of modern web applications, AI-enabled solutions, and digital platforms used to support pharmaceutical forecasting and analytics. Through hands-on project work and collaboration with cross-functional teams, you will deepen your technical expertise, develop an understanding of pharmaceutical business needs, and build a strong foundation for a consulting career. Location Gurgoan, India Why consider Viscadia as your next career step Since our founding in 2010, Viscadia has grown from a startup to a global team that works alongside the companies shaping life sciences. We are dedicated to promoting a positive and supportive work environment where everyone can thrive. Our culture is collaborative by design, with teams across three regions operating as one. We are looking for people who want to grow with us and are excited to help shape what comes next. Roles and Responsibilities Technical Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, responsive, and user-friendly web applications for internal and client-facing platforms. Build modern frontend applications using JavaScript/TypeScript, React (Next.js is a plus), HTML, and CSS. Develop backend services and application logic using Node.js with TypeScript (e.g., Express or NestJS) as the primary stack, with Python or other relevant backend frameworks as additional options. Design, develop, and integrate RESTful APIs and backend services, including data retrieval, validation, authentication, error handling, and service-to-service communication. Work with relational and/or NoSQL databases; design data models, write efficient queries, and ensure data integrity and performance. Build and maintain end-to-end application functionality, including reusable UI components, application state management, routing, forms, authentication, and backend integrations. Integrate AI capabilities into web applications using large language model (LLM) APIs and AI services, primarily through JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs (e.g., OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK), to build practical, user-focused features such as streaming responses and tool/function calling. Develop and integrate AI-powered workflows such as conversational interfaces, document/data extraction, summarization, intelligent search, and workflow automation. Work with concepts and tools such as prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to build context-aware AI applications. Evaluate and improve AI application outputs for accuracy, relevance, reliability, and latency; implement appropriate validation, error handling, and human review where required. Follow secure and responsible development practices when working with application data and AI services, including appropriate access controls and protection of sensitive information. Write clean, modular, maintainable, and well-documented code; perform debugging, testing, and performance optimization across frontend, backend, and AI-enabled components. Use Git-based source control, participate in code reviews, and contribute to CI/CD, cloud deployment, and application monitoring processes. Design and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS (or Azure/GCP) using services such as compute (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda), object storage (S3), managed databases, API gateways, and queue/event services. Provision and manage infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation); build containerized (Docker) deployments and automated CI/CD pipelines across development, staging, and production environments. Own system design for scalable, reliable, and secure platforms: define architecture, service boundaries, data flows, caching, and asynchronous/event-driven processing, balancing scalability, availability, latency, and cost; document decisions through architecture diagrams and design documents. Implement observability (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting), cloud security (IAM, secrets management, network isolation, encryption), and cost optimization for deployed applications and AI workloads. Work closely with product, design, data, and engineering teams; participate in technical design discussions and contribute to application architecture and technology decisions. Stay current with full-stack engineering, AI/LLM frameworks, cloud technologies, and emerging development practices, and identify opportunities to improve products and engineering productivity. Business Responsibilities Support the development and enhancement of forecasting and analytics platforms tailored to the needs of pharmaceutical clients across various therapeutic areas. Build an understanding of pharma forecasting concepts, disease areas, treatment landscapes, and market dynamics to contextualize platform features and user workflows. Translate business and functional requirements into intuitive web experiences and AI-enabled features that help users analyze information, access insights, and make informed decisions. Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure product features and deliverables align with client objectives, timelines, and decision-making needs. Participate in requirement discussions, solutioning, demos, and feedback sessions to continuously improve platform usability and functionality. Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement by documenting technical approaches, reusable patterns, and best practices. Develop the ability to independently own technical workstreams and progressively take responsibility for delivering end-to-end solutions. Skills & Technical Proficiencies Technical Skills Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript across frontend and Node.js backend, with a solid understanding of modern language features, asynchronous programming, and object-oriented/functional programming concepts. Hands-on experience with React and its ecosystem, including component-based development, hooks, routing, state management, and responsive UI development. Experience with backend development using Node.js/TypeScript (preferred), Python, or a similar language/framework, including building and consuming REST APIs. Working knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL and/or NoSQL databases; ability to write queries and work with data models. Understanding of full-stack application architecture, authentication/authorization, API design, application security, error handling, and performance optimization. Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs or cloud-based services into web applications; familiarity with JSON and asynchronous workflows. Practical exposure to generative AI/LLM integration, such as using OpenAI or other LLM APIs from JavaScript/TypeScript applications to build AI-powered features, including streaming responses, structured outputs, and tool/function calling. Understanding of prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG); experience building RAG-based applications is an advantage. Familiarity with AI frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangChain/LangChain.js, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or the Vercel AI SDK, and with evaluating and improving AI-generated outputs, is preferred. Experience with Git, testing practices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as AWS (or Azure/GCP); working knowledge of Docker and application monitoring. Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation), including networking, IAM, containers, and serverless services. Solid grasp of system design principles: scalability, high availability, caching, message queues, microservices vs. monolith trade-offs, API and data-model design, and the ability to explain design choices through architecture diagrams. Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, and AI-integrated workflows. Soft Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in cross-functional teams. Strong ownership and attention to detail, with a focus on delivering high-quality and reliable solutions. Adaptable and proactive, with a willingness to learn new technologies and thrive in a dynamic, fast-growing environment. Genuine interest in consulting and technology, with a focus on delivering tangible business value for clients. Domain Expertise (Good to have) Understanding of pharmaceutical commercial models, forecasting concepts, treatment journeys, market dynamics, or key therapeutic areas. Experience working with healthcare, pharmaceutical, commercial analytics, forecasting, or other data-intensive applications. Familiarity with industry-standard pharmaceutical datasets such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, or similar secondary data sources. Qualifications Required Bachelor s degree (B.Tech/B.E.) from a recognized engineering institute, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 2+ years of professional experience in full-stack development, software engineering, or web application development. Hands-on experience developing production-grade web applications using a modern frontend framework (preferably React) and a backend technology such as Node.js/TypeScript (preferred) or Python. Experience integrating APIs and databases; exposure to building or integrating AI/LLM-powered features is strongly preferred. Working knowledge of cloud deployment (preferably AWS), containerization, and system design fundamentals; AWS or equivalent cloud certification is an advantage. Benefits Competitive Compensation & Performance Incentives: We offer a highly competitive compensation package, complemented by performance-based incentives that reward excellence, innovation, and leadership. To support your transition, we also provide relocation assistance and reimbursement for moving closer to our office location. In addition, Gratuity, as applicable, is paid in accordance with The Payment of Gratuity Act, over & above the CTC. Comprehensive Health & Wellness Benefits: Our benefits are thoughtfully designed to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being. From health insurance and wellness programs to flexible work arrangements, we prioritize your holistic success and balance. Generous Leave policy: Our leave framework includes, but is not limited to, Sick leave, casual leave, earned leave, bereavement leave, maternity & paternity leave - ensuring you have the flexibility and support you need at different stages of life. Global Exposure & Collaborative Culture: Work in a high-impact, intellectually stimulating environment that values collaboration, diversity, and continuous learning. You will have opportunities to engage with global clients, cross-functional teams, and industry thought leaders across geographies. Career Development & Growth Pathways: At Viscadia, your growth is our priority. We offer structured career development programs, leadership training, and opportunities to expand your expertise through global projects, conferences, and innovation initiatives. Viscadia is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status. Location Gurgaon, India Role CIT / Innovation Consulting Consulting - Platforms Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. jobs.description: : We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Automation Engineer to join our E2E QA team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading automation activities, developing and maintaining automation scripts, and ensuring the quality and stability of our products through comprehensive testing strategies. You will play a pivotal role in validating the entire Amadeus product ecosystem by running end-to-end tests, managing defect life cycles, and ensuring smooth delivery of releases before production. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Application Development, Product Management, and DevOps, to achieve optimal product performance. Key Responsibilities: Test Strategy and Planning: Participate in specification and architecture reviews, including customer specification reviews, to identify potential risks, gaps, and issues. Investigate and test fixes for PTRs, maintaining and enriching test suites. Test Automation: Develop and maintain automation frameworks and scripts using Java, Selenium, Groovy, TypeScript, and Python. Conduct peer reviews of automation scripts to ensure adherence to quality standards. Collaborate with functional teams to maintain a strong understanding of the product ecosystem and develop relevant test scenarios. Influence functional teams to improve test coverage and ensure comprehensive business scenarios. Lead daily automated test campaigns, analyzing results, identifying defects, and collaborating with developers for resolution. Defect Management: Open, manage, and track defects, assigning appropriate severity levels based on issue impact. Perform defect validation, providing go/no-go decisions for production deployments based on fixes. Provide detailed defect reports and track resolution progress. DevOps: Proactively maintain Linux infrastructure to ensure 24/7 uptime and support for the operating system platform. Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, continuously improving processes. Support migration to the cloud and manage RedHat Linux systems administration solutions. Implement and maintain operational tools for deployment, monitoring, and analysis of public cloud infrastructure. Ensure CI/CD solutions are implemented and functioning as expected. Engage in system troubleshooting and issue resolution across platforms and applications. Solid experience in Linux systems administration, particularly with RedHat and related technologies. Familiarity with BDD frameworks like Spock and Geb. Expertise in end-to-end testing and test automation practices, including regression testing and performance testing. Strong experience in defect management and maintaining high-quality standards in production environments. Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Knowledge of the travel domain is a plus. Familiarity with AI/ML concepts is an added advantage.
